title: Google\Cloud\AutoMl\V1\ImageClassificationModelDeploymentMetadata
name: ImageClassificationModelDeploymentMetadata
description: Model deployment metadata specific to Image Classification.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.node_count
params.description: Input only. The number of nodes to deploy the model on. A node is an abstraction of a machine resource, which can handle online prediction QPS as given in the model's [node_qps][google.cloud.automl.v1.ImageClassificationModelMetadata.node_qps]. Must be between 1 and 100, inclusive on both ends.
